scope: retrospective observed-game research; no original lineup reproduction, live deployment or forecast promotion

rb.scope: historical component replay; only derived-usage timing differs, not the complete serving pipeline
rb.cohort_definition: WR/TE low usage: prior-four-game targets <=2; RB/FB: prior-four-game carries+targets <=5. Missing histories separate.
limitations: Observed regular-season PPR stat rows; inactive/unrecorded player weeks are not reconstructed.
No salary archives or complete platform-specific scoring; low prior usage is not a cheap-player cohort.
2025 has previously been explored and is not an untouched holdout.
Historical source revisions are not archived pregame inputs; lagged market averages remain closing-line proxies, with no current-game market features.
Cold-start rows isolate compatibility-imputed component inputs, not historical live-roster/template fallback behavior.
Median error, tail scores and input parity do not establish mean accuracy, zero-score probabilities or contest profitability.
Training unchanged heads offline for this experiment does not promote or replace serving models.

zero_score.event: Exactly zero PPR fantasy points in an observed player-stat row; negative scores are nonzero.

specification.preprocessing: Train-only median imputation with missing indicators and retained empty columns, then standard scaling

baselines.usage: Training-only prior-target bucket prevalence pooled toward global with strength 4

specification.reliability_bins: Ten fixed equal-width bins; final bin includes probability one
